name: com.roadcutco/roadcut
title: Roadcut — European road trips
description: Checked European road trips day by day, live EV chargers, pass seasons and driving rules.

tools.name: find_road_trips
tools.description: Search Roadcut's European road trip itineraries by country, number of days or keywords (e.g. "fjords", "Alps", "coast", a town). Returns matching trips with days, km and a link.

query.description: Free-text keywords: a place, region, landscape or theme.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Norway" or "NO".

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

travel_date.description: When the user will drive (YYYY-MM-DD), to check seasonal passes. Default today.

tools.name: get_road_trip
tools.description: Day-by-day overview of one Roadcut road trip: from, to, km and where to sleep each day, highlights, ferries, seasonal mountain passes on the way, a cost estimate, EV charging along the road (stations, fast chargers, longest stretch without one), and links to the full plan and the interactive planner. A trip is identified by its slug.

travel_date.description: When the user will drive (YYYY-MM-DD), to check seasonal passes. Default today.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

tools.name: get_driving_rules
tools.description: Speed limits, drink-driving limit, winter tyre, stud and chain rules, the car equipment a driver must carry (and whether it applies to foreign-registered cars) and fines for common offences in a European country, each with the official sources and the date Roadcut last checked them.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Austria" or "AT".

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

tools.name: get_mountain_pass
tools.description: When a European mountain pass (Alps, Norway, Carpathians…) usually opens and closes, whether it opened this year, night closures, and where the road operator publishes live status. Search by pass name or country; with neither, every pass Roadcut tracks is listed. Seasons are records of past years, not live status; each result links to the operator's live status.

name.description: Pass name or part of it, e.g. "Trollstigen", "Stelvio".

travel_date.description: When the user will drive (YYYY-MM-DD), to check seasonal passes. Default today.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

tools.name: get_live_chargers
tools.description: Fast chargers (DC or 50 kW and more) within 2 km of one Roadcut road trip, with how many are free, in use or out of order now, power, card payment and, where published, the price without an app: in euros, or in the local currency in its own field for Poland (PLN), Denmark (DKK) and the UK (GBP); for Norway and Sweden the networks' published list price in NOK or SEK, not a live price. Refreshed about every 20 minutes from open operator data. Live status exists for Germany, the Netherlands, France, Finland, Poland, Slovenia, Luxembourg, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Belgium, Lithuania and Switzerland, and in the UK for IONITY and Blink Charging only. Swiss stations have status but no price; their source, "Bundesamt für Energie BFE / ich-tanke-strom.ch", is in `sources` and in each Swiss station's `source` field. Austrian chargers are not in this tool: their source does not allow passing the data on, so they are shown on roadcutco.com only. A trip is identified by its slug.

only_free.description: Only stations with at least one free charger. Default false.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

tools.name: plan_custom_trip
tools.description: A link that opens the Roadcut planner with a trip from any start to any destination in Europe, optionally through the user's own stops and back home. When opened, the planner works out the road, splits it into driving days with a place to sleep each night, and shows hotels, EV chargers, fuel, vignettes and tolls along the way; the user can then add stops, move nights and change days. The plan is computed in the planner, not returned here. Coordinates make the link exact; without them the planner looks the place names up (and own stops then need coordinates too).

start.description: Where the trip starts, e.g. the user's home town.

name.description: Place name as the user would say it, e.g. "Brno".
Place name as the user would say it, e.g. "Brno".
Place name as the user would say it, e.g. "Brno".

stops.description: Places to drive through on the way out, each with coordinates. Up to 15.

days.description: Days for the whole trip, including any days spent at the destination. Without it the planner uses the pace.

round_trip.description: Drive back to the start at the end. Default false.

extra_days.description: When `days` is more than the driving needs: spend the spare days at the destination (default) or spread them along the road.

pace.description: Driving per day: easy about 180 km, medium 280 km (default), fast 380 km.

road.description: Which road to take. Default fastest.

start_date.description: First day of the trip (YYYY-MM-DD), for the weather and pass warnings in the planner.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.
